data.name: Yuvank
data.gender_notes: Yuvank is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yuvank is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the words 'yuva' (youth) and 'ank' (energy or power). In Hindu mythology, Yuvank represents the energy and power of youth, and is often associated with the divine god Krishna, who embodies the eternal youth and joy of life. The name Yuvank carries the meaning “Youth, Energy, Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Yuvank usually hope their child will grow to embody youth, energy, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the vitality and energy of youth, and the potential for growth and transformation.
data.etymology: Yuvank belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youth, Energy, Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yuvank total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
